_doc: One file per place; see places_build.py. Amounts in THB. The debt component and history are refreshed by pipeline/fetch_thailand.py from the official source named below; edit wording here, not numbers.
name: Thailand
publisher: Public Debt Management Office (PDMO), Ministry of Finance of Thailand
title: Thailand Debt Clock: Live Public Debt, Official Data
headline: public debt
subject: The Kingdom of Thailand
sum_note: Thailand's total public debt outstanding (government, state-owned enterprise, government-guaranteed financial SOE and government agency debt), month-end, from the PDMO's monthly summary.
scope_note: This is the "public debt" that the PDMO states in its monthly Public Debt Status Summary: government debt plus the debt of state-owned enterprises, government-guaranteed financial SOE debt and government agency debt, in baht at month-end. It is the PDMO's own headline total, the one it quotes as a share of GDP. Government debt alone is about nine-tenths of it. It is gross and domestic plus foreign currency debt together.
trend_why: The PDMO page lists only the latest few monthly summaries, so we use the change since the earliest one we could read (end of May 2026) rather than a full year. The window lengthens as new months are read.
legend: Thailand's public debt is reported at period-end. Issuance happens in lumps at auctions and maturities, so the live number is a straight-line projection between official figures, shown here next to them.
cadence: Monthly. The PDMO publishes each month-end summary at the end of the following month.
after_text: , about a month after each month-end
next_update: The PDMO publishes the Public Debt Status Summary at the end of the following month; this page re-bases to it automatically on the next daily build after it appears.

population.source_name: World Bank, World Development Indicators, Population, total (SP.POP.TOTL), Thailand, 2025 (UN Population Division and national statistical offices)
population.method_short: World Bank 2025 population estimate, all ages

components.label: Thailand public debt
components.source_name: PDMO, Public Debt Status Summary (monthly), total public debt outstanding, THB million
components.source_locator: First paragraph of each monthly summary: "At the end of <month> <year>, Thailand's public debt amounted to … million Baht"
components.includes: Total public debt outstanding as the PDMO defines it: government debt, state-owned enterprise debt, government-guaranteed financial SOE debt and government agency debt, in baht.

extra_sources.name: Bank of Thailand, Government debt statistics

notes: Why the PDMO summary: it is the debt office's own monthly total, and the number Thailand's official debt-to-GDP ratio is built on. Government debt alone is a smaller figure; the Bank of Thailand also publishes a government-debt table.

The PDMO page lists only the latest few monthly summaries, so the trend starts from the earliest of those and the page keeps every month it has read; the window grows toward twelve months as the daily build collects them.
Currency: Thai baht. The World Debt Clock converts at the ECB's daily reference rate for the baht.
trend_pace: the pace since the end of May 2026, the earliest month the PDMO page lets us use as a base
